SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. 5, Special Branch
REPORT
File No. **〔此处转录不清〕**
STRY
Date Feb. 23, 19 39.

Subject "Erh Tung Jih Pao" - Application for Registration with
S.M.P.

Made by D. S. Henchman Forwarded by **〔此处转录不清〕**

With reference to the attached communication
from Mr. Alexander H. Buchman, U.S.A. citizen (File
D-5257), and his application for registration with the
S.M.P. of his recent acquisition, the "Erh Tung Jih
Pao" (兒童日報), it has been ascertained that despite
the owner's request, the U.S.A. authorities have no
intention of accepting the registration of this
publication.

Huang Yih-teh (黄一德), mentioned in the
accompanying application as the editor of the "Erh
Tung Jih Pao", was formerly the editor of a mosquito
daily of identical designation; this daily made its
first appearance in September, 1935, and ceased
publication at the outbreak of hostilities in 1937.
Huang Yih-teh who at one time was connected with the
Erh Tung Bookstore (兒童書局), 424 Foochow Road, is
now resident at 3, Lane 826, Haining Road.

Mr. Buchman states that he does not intend to
register this paper as a Chinese publication.

**〔此处转录不清：签名〕**
D. S.

D. C. (Special Branch).

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
S. 5，特别支部
报告
档案号 **〔此处转录不清〕**
STRY
日期 1939年2月23日。

事由 “Erh Tung Jih Pao”（儿童日报）——向上海公共租界工部局警务处申请注册

由 D. S. Henchman 提交 转呈者 **〔此处转录不清〕**

关于附呈的美国公民 Alexander H. Buchman 先生（档案 D-5257）的来函及其就其近期收购的“Erh Tung Jih Pao”（儿童日报）向上海公共租界工部局警务处申请注册一事，经查实，尽管所有者提出请求，美国当局无意接受该出版物的注册。

随附申请中提及的“Erh Tung Jih Pao”编辑黄一德（Huang Yih-teh），曾任同名小型日报的编辑；该日报于1935年9月首次发行，并于1937年战事爆发时停刊。黄一德曾一度与位于福州路424号的儿童书局（Erh Tung Bookstore）有关联，现居住在海宁路826弄3号。

Buchman 先生表示，他不打算将该报作为中文出版物进行注册。

**〔此处转录不清：签名〕**
D. S.

D. C.（特别支部）。

Dear Sir:

With reference to my application for
registration of the TEH TUNG JIH PAO, I should
like the registration to remain unaltered, that
is to say, that I am applying for registration
of the paper as an American-owned paper.

Very truly yours,

Alexander H. Buchman

Room 25, 3rd floor
9 Avenue Edward VII
Shanghai

16 February 1938

Mr. D. J. Ross
Room 609
Central Police Station
Present

Dear Mr. Ross:

In accordance with the request of your
department, I have asked Mr. Huang Yih-teh, Editor of
the Trh Tung Jih Pao, to visit you.

Subsequent to my application, Mr. Huang informed me
that the Trh Tung Jih Pao was registered in 1935 with
both the S.M.C. and F.M.C. Would you be good enough,
therefore, to inform me whether re-registration is
required, and if not, whether I may immediately resume
publication and circulation of the paper?

I shall be glad to send you a sample copy of the paper
at your request, or to give you any further information
you may require with regard to the Trh Tung Jih Pao.

Very truly yours,
Alexander H. Buchman
Alexander H. Buchman

电话 84355
爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）9号三楼25室
上海

1938年2月16日

D. J. Ross 先生
中央捕房609室
现交

亲爱的 Ross 先生：

应贵部门要求，我已请 Trh Tung Jih Pao 的编辑黄一德（Huang Yih-teh）先生拜访您。

在我提出申请后，黄先生告知我，Trh Tung Jih Pao 曾于1935年在工部局和法公董局均进行过注册。因此，能否请您告知是否需要重新注册，如果不需要，我是否可以立即恢复该报的出版和发行？

如蒙要求，我很乐意寄送给您一份该报的样刊，或提供您可能需要的关于 Trh Tung Jih Pao 的任何进一步信息。

您忠实的，
Alexander H. Buchman

Dear Sir:

    Mr. F. K. Ingdahl of the American Consulate-
General (Telephone 11199) has suggested that I re-
quest you to get in touch with him with regard to
the American Consulate's knowledge of the affairs of
the Alexander Publishing and Printing Company and the
Erh Tung Jih Pao.

    I would greatly appreciate it if you would
inform me at your earliest convenience of your
decision with regard to the registration of the
Erh Tung Jih Pao.

Yours truly,

Alexander H. Buchman

Shanghai, China Feb. 14 1939

Political Department

GENTLEMEN:
This is to inform you that I have
purchased the ERH TUNG JIH PAO, a children's
daily paper, and am sending herewith the Editor,
MR. HUANG YIH-TEH, to register the paper with
you.
Should any questions or difficulties
arise in this matter, kindly communicate with
me at my office, Room 25, 3rd Floor, 9 Avenue
Edward VII, Telephone 84365.

Very truly yours,
Alexander H. Buchman
